name: newtone_tune_save_gui
verified_note: Confirmed on FL 26.1.7 at 2560x1440 on 2026-10-29: three full runs in a row through apply_vocal_tuning_gui (robotic, middle, smooth on the Girlish vocal), each saving the tuned WAV and the MIDI and closing Newtone; the three takes measured as intended (robotic 5.0 cents off the semitone, 61 % of frames within 10 cents of their note; middle 8.7, 44 %; smooth 11.3, 36 %). Draft from measured positions on FL 26.1.7 at 2560x1440 (2026-10-29). Opens Newtone from the clip menu of the audio clip at the start of playlist track 1, loads {path} (Ctrl+O), selects every note (Select menu > Select all (slices)), turns the three knobs to their values read back from the screen, then saves the tuned audio (Ctrl+S) and the notes (File > Save as MIDI). Knob travel is 0 to 1: CENTER 0 leaves each note's pitch centre, 1 puts it on the semitone; VARIATION 0.5 (its reset value) keeps the voice's own vibrato and drift, 0 flattens it, 1 doubles it; TRANS 1 (its reset value) keeps the voice's glides between notes, 0 jumps. The first robotic take on 2026-10-29 set VARIATION to 1 thinking it removed vibrato and came out wobblier than the input.
summary: Pitch-correct a sandbox audio file in Newtone with given CENTER, VARIATION and TRANS, and save the audio and its notes as MIDI.
source: measured on this install; Image-Line manual: Center (global pitch correction toward the nearest pitch), Variation (vibrato and pitch errors), Transition (pitch transition speed between notes); these scale all notes
